why: Today's lead tooling adds the fixed two-case manual exercise. Eight deliberate unit/static breaks each failed their named assertion and were restored. No real adapter, integration law or remote dispatch ran. Typecheck and the final changed-test selection belong to the lead. Main's global fixed seed and plant-option extension are absent; no setup or dependency was changed. Model usage and list-price cost were unavailable to this bounded worker and remain unknown.

plants.law: only exact case and SHA requests decode
each case derives exactly one fixed byte edit and refuses ambiguous layouts
plants.plant: replace every occurrence instead of requiring exactly one

plants.law: the byte edit cannot hide a changed index, mode, HEAD or extra path
plants.plant: check allowed paths but ignore bytes or index

plants.law: only actual selected assertion results become phase observations
plants.plant: accept exit 1 without a failed target assertion

plants.law: public observations copy no generated private diagnostic content
every acquired source restores after an injected I/O failure
plants.plant: skip scoped restoration after the broken child fails

plants.law: phase walks record only pass, failure, pass and keep incomplete answers terminal
valid YAML forms pass and changed execution policy is refused
plants.plant: accept a raw report upload or arbitrary command
